hint: Draw with a pointer or choose a shape and add it with the button. Select an element to edit its coordinates, move it with arrow keys, or delete it. Shift + arrow moves by ten units. Sketch coordinates describe a drawing, not calibrated measurements.
limit: The sketch exceeds its supported bounds or limits (200 elements, 2,048 points per stroke, 20,000 points overall). The last change was not applied.
invalid: Complete the annotation text and keep coordinates inside the canvas.
exportError: The sketch could not be downloaded. Keep this editor open and try again.
changed: Sketch updated. Apply content to keep these changes in the record.
